newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish crown firms vs dollar, debt unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Swedish crown firms vs dollar, debt unchanged.

text.p: 0715 GMT - The Swedish crown firmed against a weaker dollar early Thursday and was slightly firmer against the mark. Debt yields were unchanged.
Dealers said growing speculation about an interest rate hike in Germany was capping the dollar.
The main focus of the day was the U.S. Q2 GDP data.
* Six-month T-bill rate unchanged at 4.29 pct
* Crown steady at 4.3320 to mark vs 4.3385 late Wednesday
* Crown firms against dollar to 7.9441 vs 7.9971 Wednesday
